focus_areas: Depth ordering of paws relative to the white object (Geometric Depth).
Boundary integrity between hamster fur and the white object (Topology + OVD).
Legitimacy of background graphical elements (Text Auditor).
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interaction between the hamster's front paws and the white object. Use the geometric depth map to confirm the paws are physically gripping (in front of) the object, not floating. Ensure the topology auditor uses the bounding boxes from the open-vocabulary detector to cleanly separate the fur from the white edge. Verify that the 'gibberish' in the background does not contain hidden valid text.
image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a golden Syrian hamster gripping the edge of a white paper or cardboard structure. The hamster has dense golden-brown fur, prominent black eyes, and rounded ears. Its front paws are visible holding the object, showing small digits. The background features a dark surface with colorful, possibly circus-themed graphics (red and yellow stripes).
